Chapter 954: Chapter 15 I Know A Little About Everything (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 954: Chapter 15 I Know a Little About Everything (Please Subscribe)_2

“Rest assured, once we have locked onto the position of the Galaxy Master, leave the rest to us,” the Ultimate of the Prison Tribe said with a smile.

In fact, the Nine-day Worship Secret Technique is a kind of Curse-Killing Skill that carries out the curse by exploiting the strongest causal connection after worshiping the nine days.

But curse-killing is not fail-safe. Knowing that the Galaxy Master has a causality-related treasure for protection, even with the Nine-day Worship Secret Technique, it’s still not foolproof.

And what if we end up curse-killing the Galaxy Master? The Galaxy Master has not yet ascended to the Twelfth Layer; his life essence imprint is still within the Time River, which can be resurrected by the strongest among human civilization.

Therefore, the safest method is to pinpoint the location of one of the Galaxy Master’s avatars through the Nine-day Worship Secret Technique, then all of us at the Twelfth Layer converge to suppress the Galaxy Master in a lightning-fast move, and use that drop of bizarre blood to contaminate the Galaxy Master.

This is the most perfect strategy to deal with the Galaxy Master.

“We don’t need to completely kill the Galaxy Master; we just need that drop of bizarre blood to influence the Galaxy Master so that he ultimately fails at a critical moment,” they said.

The Ultimates of the Twelfth Layer exchanged glances and nodded slightly.

…

“Then I shall begin.”

Ultimate Lord Fan of the Cosmos Tribe took a deep breath. His true self, situated deep within the territory of the Cosmos Tribe, knelt down, with many pieces of information about the Galaxy Master surfacing in his mind.

In an instant, a causal connection between him and the Galaxy Master was formed.

Following that, with every bow Ultimate Lord Fan directed at Lin Yuan, the causal link between them grew stronger.

…

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan was unaware of the conspiracies of the alien Twelfth Layers.

He simply felt that, so far, those alien Twelfth Layers haven’t even been able to lock onto his deliberately exposed Primordial Spirit avatar, and probably lacked even the qualification to have a final confrontation with him.

“However, it seems that those Ultimates of the Twelfth Layer have not made any moves against my teachers?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound. Ever since he learned from the Robber Clan a hundred years ago that the alien Twelfth Layers wanted to target him, he asked Xia Qin and other supremely powerful figures to pay more attention to the Chikun Star Lord, and the situation with his parents and family.

Moreover, Lin Yuan took away a sliver of their spiritual will and placed it in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to prevent the most extreme situations from occurring.

“Twelfth Layer…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged as he began preparing for the final assault on the Twelfth Layer.

At this moment, within the Time River, Lin Yuan’s form was nearly larger than the river itself; if he did not curl up as much as possible at the riverbed, it seemed that the entire Time River would not be able to contain him.

“I feel that if I were to stand up, the depth of the entire Time River would only reach my waist,” Lin Yuan quietly thought to himself.

Other Level Eleven Perfect powerhouses might be able to leap from within the river by exerting their full strength, momentarily staying above the river for an instant.

Even so, this would come at the cost of almost all their focus at the Level Eleven Perfect; when assaulting the Twelfth Layer, they first have to withstand the Chaos Void Origin Infusion to have more confidence in leaping out of the Time River.

But Lin Yuan?

He doesn’t need to make a forceful leap at all; just gently standing up would allow most of his form to appear outside of the Time River.

“With my current life essence and my many foundations, the probability of ascending to the Twelfth Layer is at least ninety-five percent,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As for the remaining 0.5 percent… it stems from the uncertainty of the vast Chaos Void.

…

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly shifted.

“The Martial Arts Evolution Road has finally birthed its first Eighth Layer?”

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the space-time had reached the Seventh Realm, and with the identity of the Ancestor of Martial Arts, he could vaguely sense all those in the universe who practice Martial Tao and evolve.

“Not bad.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

In the Central Divine China World, after accumulating over millions of years in the Spirit Realm, the limit Martial Tao experts also reached only the Eighth Layer, and that was the result of Lin Yuan’s forceful cultivation.

But in the Main Universe, in less than a thousand years, the first Eighth Layer Martial Tao was born.

The main reason is the almost systematic cultivation methods of the Main Universe human civilization, where the once-mysterious path of cultivation is openly laid out.

Together with guidance from many higher-level evolutionary beings and so on, the development trend of the Martial Arts Evolution Road in the Main Universe far surpasses the Spirit Realm, and even the Immortal Realm cannot match it.

“Well, before the ultimate ascent, let’s meet this little guy,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Decades ago, to encourage Martial Arts Evolutionaries to diligently cultivate, Lin Yuan posted a status from the account of the founder of Martial Tao.

That is, whoever steps into the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao first, could meet him in person.

…

A Barbaric Wilderness Planet.

A figure sat cross-legged.

“The Eighth Layer of Martial Tao, this is the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao!”

The figure was full of energy, and a world’s breath faintly emanated from within his body, as if a small world had been opened.

The figure was named Zhang Tianzhi, a Seventh Stage Martial Tao peak evolutionary, and not long ago, he just opened his own internal world, stepping into the Eighth Layer of Martial Tao.

So far, among humanity’s Martial Arts Evolution Road, the strongest were only at the Seventh Layer, and no one had yet heard of the existence of the Eighth Layer.

In other words, at this moment, he, Zhang Tianzhi, is very likely the first Martial Arts Evolutionary below the Ancestor of Martial Arts to step into the Eighth Layer.

“Using the physical body as the foundation, advancing blood, spirit, soul, and heart in unison, the path of Martial Arts Evolution indeed befits mankind’s fifth.” As Zhang Tianzhi continuously felt the changes within his body, his reverence for the Ancestor of Martial Arts who opened the path of Martial Arts Evolution grew ever deeper.

He had merely walked on the already perfected road of Martial Arts Evolution and already encountered its profound mysteries. Then what kind of existence would the Ancestor of Martial Arts, the one who pioneered this evolutionary path, be?

“Someone is looking for me?”

Zhang Tianzhi suddenly blinked, the Goddess of Wisdom directly contacted him, reminding him that someone was looking for him.

“The Ancestor of Martial Arts is inviting me?”

Upon seeing who was contacting him, Zhang Tianzhi immediately became stupefied – the Ancestor of Martial Arts was looking for him?

“Right, the Ancestor of Martial Arts once said, whoever first steps into the Eighth Layer, could meet him…” Zhang Tianzhi recalled this.

As a Martial Arts Evolutionary, he naturally remembered every single status the Ancestor of Martial Arts had posted.

“But… I’ve only just broken through, and haven’t told anyone yet, how did the Ancestor of Martial Arts know?” Zhang Tianzhi did not dare to delay and immediately agreed.

Suddenly.

A strand of Zhang Tianzhi’s spiritual will was pulled into a personal world.

After being promoted to a Level Eleven citizen, Lin Yuan’s many privileges reached their peak, his personal space underwent maximal expansion, becoming a personal world.

“I’ve seen the Ancestor of Martial Arts.” As soon as Zhang Tianzhi saw a blurred figure standing in the center of the world, he immediately went over to offer his respects.

“You are not bad.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The transition from the Seventh Layer to the Eighth Layer in Martial Tao is a qualitative change, involving the creation of an internal world within one’s body.

Of course, in the Martial Arts Evolution Road that Lin Yuan established, as long as one reaches the most perfect state, it is completely possible to create an internal world before breaking through to the Seventh Layer, but this is very difficult.

“If you have any questions about cultivation, you can ask them.” Lin Yuan looked at Zhang Tianzhi and spoke.

Since he had personally met Zhang Tianzhi, it was just a light effort to provide him some guidance.

“Thank you, Ancestor of Martial Arts…”

Upon hearing this, Zhang Tianzhi’s spirit was lifted.

Personal guidance from the Ancestor of Martial Arts? If word of this spread, countless Evolutionaries would be envious of him, Zhang Tianzhi.

“In thousands of years of cultivation, I have tried many evolutionary paths and discovered that many pathways have their own focus on the comprehension of rules…”

Zhang Tianzhi immediately voiced his question.

Before cultivating on the Martial Arts Evolutionary path, he was already a Seventh-Rank Peak evolutionary, having tried dozens of evolutionary paths, and found each specialized in different aspects.

He wanted to know if there was any evolutionary path in this world that encompassed them all.

“That’s normal. Evolutionary paths are created by people, and people have their own strengths and weaknesses, the evolutionary paths are no exception. Even the strongest evolutionary path is like this.” Lin Yuan spoke with a smile.

“I see.” Zhang Tianzhi was enlightened.

Then Zhang Tianzhi seemed to remember something and tentatively asked cautiously, “Then, Ancestor of Martial Arts, do you have any areas of specialization?”

“Me?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm, looking at Zhang Tianzhi, who dared not look directly at him, and said with a smile, “I know a little bit of everything.”
